description: Deliberate decision not to build multi-tenancy.

uncommitted.docs/scope.md:
# Scope

- Single clinic only. No tenant_id columns.

record.prompt: Should I add tenant_id everywhere now in case we sell this to other clinics later? ... ok agreed, skip it, note it down
record.assistant: My recommendation is no, and since you agreed, I have written it into docs/scope.md: we are NOT building multi-tenancy now. The contract is with one clinic, there's no second customer in sight, and adding tenant_id to every table and query would cost roughly a week plus a permanent tax on every query and test. If a second clinic signs, deploying a separate instance per clinic is a viable path that needs no schema changes. The risk we accept is a costlier migration if we later want a shared multi-tenant deployment.

must_capture.fact: because only one clinic / no second customer
